name: shipin-kit
description: ShipinKit — unified Swift SDK (视频 = shipin = video) for AI video generation on Apple platforms. Integrates LumaAI Dream Machine and RunwayML Gen-3 Alpha via Swift async/await.
author: rryam (Rudrank Riyam)

api_surface.LumaAI: Direct actor — createGeneration, getGeneration, listGenerations, deleteGeneration
api_surface.RunwayML: Direct actor — generateVideo, getTask, processTask, cancelTask, deleteTask
api_surface.ShipinImage: Cross-platform image wrapper (UIImage on iOS, NSImage on macOS, URL)

security_review.notes: Swift 6 actor-based SDK. Uses only URLSession for HTTPS API calls. No Process(), no shell execution, no eval of remote content. Build script uses standard xcodebuild. CI uploads to EmergeTools (size analysis service).
